scope: All 57 behavioral, OptiFine menu, and shader-toggle captures for the fresh Forge 1.20.2 publisher OptiFine I7 pre1 active Complementary Reimagined 5.9.3 row.
findings: Publisher OptiFine I7 pre1 visibly loads publisher Complementary Reimagined 5.9.3 in all active scenes.
Both entity sequences visibly select OFF and then reselect the exact ComplementaryReimagined_r5.9.3.zip entry through native OptiFine menus.
Shaders-off captures visibly switch to vanilla rendering and restored captures return to Complementary rendering, agreeing with the active/false/active probe states.
Ghost and Wraith are recognizable across day, night, native rain, backgrounds, indoor, movement, damage, invisibility, spectator, and outline states.
Registered block surfaces and lit states, armor and glint, inventory previews, projectiles, and the populated Spectral Infuser GUI are present and legible.
